name: dsh-game-studio
description: Build playable 2D Canvas and 3D Three.js games, verify with headless Chrome playtests, generate transparent AI sprites, export < 4 MB WeChat Mini Games with CLI upload, and publish permanent links to GitHub Pages.

interface.shortDescription: Build 2D/3D games, playtest in Chrome, swap AI sprites, and export WeChat Mini Games
interface.longDescription: Create playable 2D Canvas and 3D Three.js WebGL games from clean starter templates, run automated headless Chrome playtests (including WeChat Mini Game top-right capsule safe-area simulation), generate alpha-checked AI sprites via OpenAI or Codex CLI, export < 4 MB WeChat Mini Game packages with submission drafts, and publish permanent playable links to GitHub Pages.
capabilities: Headless Chrome playtest & WeChat capsule check
Generate & crop transparent AI game sprites
Export < 4 MB WeChat Mini Game & CLI upload
Publish playable links to GitHub Pages

Build a portrait 2D arcade game, playtest it in headless Chrome, and open a local preview link.
